steps.title: Multiply by the Radical Conjugate
steps.mathExpression: \frac{(\sqrt{x^2 + 4x} - x)(\sqrt{x^2 + 4x} + x)}{\sqrt{x^2 + 4x} + x} = \frac{(x^2 + 4x) - x^2}{\sqrt{x^2 + 4x} + x} = \frac{4x}{\sqrt{x^2 + 4x} + x}
steps.explanation: Multiply and divide by sqrt(x^2 + 4x) + x to resolve the oo - oo form.
steps.why: Conjugate multiplication converts oo - oo into an algebraically manageable fraction.

steps.title: Divide Numerator and Denominator by x
steps.explanation: Factor x out of both the numerator and the denominator.

steps.title: Evaluate the Limit as x -> oo
steps.why: Direct evaluation of the continuous expression after reciprocal cancellation.
